claims.claim: Meta and Sierra announced the Personal Agent Protocol (PAP), an open authorization standard designed to govern how autonomous personal AI agents interact with online businesses.
claims.notes: Solves chaotic web scraping by establishing structured agent-to-business handshakes.

claims.claim: The protocol is built on open OAuth standards, enabling granular user permission levels from read-only product queries to authorized write actions like commerce transactions.
The founding coalition includes global retail and commerce giants Walmart, Shopify, and Stripe, alongside enterprise platforms Genesys and Decagon.
claims.notes: Ensures massive commercial adoption across payment gateways and online storefronts.

editorial_cautions: Clarify that PAP v0.1 focuses on identity & authentication before full payment orchestration rollout.
Highlight the backing of major commerce titans: Walmart, Shopify, and Stripe.
